local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Create a draggable GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", player.PlayerGui)
local draggableFrame = Instance.new("Frame", screenGui)
draggableFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 100)
draggableFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.5, -50)
draggableFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)

local outlineFrame = Instance.new("Frame", draggableFrame)
outlineFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 60)
outlineFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
outlineFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
outlineFrame.BorderSizePixel = 5

local fovInput = Instance.new("TextBox", outlineFrame)
fovInput.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 40)
fovInput.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
fovInput.PlaceholderText = "Enter FOV (max 120)"

local setFovButton = Instance.new("TextButton", outlineFrame)
setFovButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 30)
setFovButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
setFovButton.Text = "Set FOV"

-- Draggable functionality
local dragging = false
local startPos

draggableFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        startPos = input.Position
    end
end)

draggableFrame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = false
    end
end)

draggableFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Position - startPos
        draggableFrame.Position = draggableFrame.Position + UDim2.new(0, delta.X, 0, delta.Y)
        startPos = input.Position
    end
end)

-- Set FOV functionality
setFovButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local fovValue = tonumber(fovInput.Text)
    if fovValue and fovValue >= 1 and fovValue <= 120 then
        camera.FieldOfView = fovValue
    else
        print("Please enter a valid FOV between 1 and 120.")
    end
end)

local NoIntroMessage = false

local function MessageGui(text, waitsec)
    -- Create a ScreenGui
    local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    screenGui.Name = "CenterBottomGui"
    screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false -- Ensures it doesn't disappear on player respawn

    -- Parent to PlayerGui
    screenGui.Parent = game.Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    -- Create a TextLabel
    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Name = "CenterBottomTextLabel"
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0.1, 0) -- 40% width, 10% height
    textLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.9, 0) -- Centered horizontally, bottom vertically
    textLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    textLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
    textLabel.BorderSizePixel = 0
    textLabel.Text = text
    textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    textLabel.TextScaled = true
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    textLabel.Parent = screenGui

    -- Run asynchronously
    coroutine.wrap(function()
        -- Wait for the specified time
        wait(waitsec)

        -- Tween the TextLabel's transparency
        local tweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
        local tween = tweenService:Create(

scripts.features:
This GUI is a user interface in Roblox that provides various interactive features for players. Below is an overview of each button's function:

1. Draggable Frame:

Allows the user to drag the GUI around the screen. This feature lets players move the interface to any position they prefer on the game screen.



2. Buttons: Each button performs a different interaction or effect when clicked. These buttons are used to provide different experiences for the players.

Bomb Button: When clicked, the player receives a "bomb" tool. The bomb creates an explosion effect and detonates after 3 seconds.

Skybox Loop Button: The game's skybox (the background sky) continuously changes. A set of images is displayed in sequence, and this loop repeats indefinitely.

Random Explosion Button: This button creates explosions at random locations. The explosions have a blast radius, affecting nearby areas and players.

Turkish Sultan Button: This button "freezes" all players and causes a block to spin above their heads. If a player is standing under the block, they "die" (their character is destroyed).

Block Spawner Button: This button spawns "blocks" at random locations. If a player touches one of these blocks, they "die" (their character is destroyed).

Message Button: Clicking this button displays a message on the screen. The message is a customized text that includes a player-specific line, for example, "XXXOMER12345678: Your brother is here, get out of here."



3. Visual and Sound Effects: Some buttons include specific visual and sound effects. For instance, the "Bomb" button triggers an explosion sound and effect. The "Skybox Loop" button changes the skybox images continuously.


4. Mobile Support: This GUI is optimized to work on mobile devices as well. The drag-and-drop functionality is designed to work smoothly on touchscreens, making it mobile-friendly.


5. User Experience: The GUI is structured in a way that allows players to interact with various game effects through simple buttons. The design focuses on both functionality and ease of use.

-- Sürüklenebilir Çerçeve (Mobil Desteği İçin)
local dragging = false
local dragInput, startPos, dragStart

local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

local function onInputBegan(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end

MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging then
        update(input)
    end
end)

end

scripts.title: PanHub AutoDodge Pathfinding
scripts.features:
Mining
- Auto Mine Ores (Credit to @realbilly as I used his args)
- LEGACY pathfind ores (recommended for island 1)
- Advanced pathfind ores (Good for island 2 as it wont walk into the water unlike legacy)
- Auto Dodge BLATANT (This is too dodge the explosions that happen from crystal after missed critical hits, this wont be a problem in private servers as you only get critical hits with auto mine but this can be good for publics if you don't wanna die to someone else missing their crit) holy yap

Auto
- Auto Sell
- Auto Upgrade
- Auto Collect Drops
- Keep Roll (Just keeps your current item basically)
- Auto Dispenser (but you have to be near it, you'd wanna do it manually anyway. )
